posts.author: Tom's Hardware
posts.text: Creator of free Adobe clones unveils open-source Microsoft Office Excel, PowerPoint, and Word replications. ArtCraft is expanding its roster of open-source creative tools as cross-platform alternatives to predatory subscription models.

posts.author: kimmonismus
posts.text: Remember the team building free, open-source alternatives to Adobe apps like Photoshop? Well, they’re taking on Microsoft Word too. WordCraft rebuilds the familiar Word workflow in Rust. Free, open source, and already available on GitHub, though still in alpha.

posts.author: 9to5Mac
posts.text: Apple testing two new features for upgraded Apple TV 4K, per report. Apple will hold its “Welcome home” product launch on Tuesday, with the headlining announcement expected to be the new “HomeView” smart display . A new Apple TV 4K is also on the docket for this week, and Apple has tested two new features for it: microphones and an upgraded Siri Remote. 9to5Mac’s Apple event coverage is supported by Sony : Shop Sony’s huge Amazon sale to score big savings on its entire TV lineup, including models with Apple AirPlay 2 support. more…

posts.author: TechCrunch AI
posts.text: Will the HomeView be Apple’s first smart home success?. Over the past couple of years, we’ve seen multiple reports that Apple was working on a new smart home product, but now it seems the product has a name and a launch date.
